title: Art Producer / Content Producer
description:
Pirate Wires is a new media brand that irreverently covers the intersection of technology, politics, and culture. Founded by Mike Solana, we reach major decision makers in technology and are a much-loved brand for the terminally online.

We are looking for a full-time content producer to create art that accompanies our high-quality articles (we publish 5-10 pieces each week) and art that works on social media as well.

CREATIVE BRIEF:

View the creative brief here

YOUR ROLE:

You will work with our Editor in Chief and our Managing Editor to create content on a regular basis for our articles and social media content. You will work within our brand guidelines to create content that develops into a consistent look and feel on our website.

This is a full-time role, remote-friendly.

ABOUT YOU:

  • you can work with occasionally challenging deadlines

  • your work is visually arresting

  • you're happy to produce content that accompanies what some people consider controversial, polemic or non-mainstream content (read a few of our articles!)

Looking forward to discussing further!
